page_title: EVE 0-0 NEW | Everton v Newcastle 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The referee has issued a yellow card to Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' What a great effort! Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
88' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

86' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball has crossed the sideline. Newcastle are taking a throw-in.
85' The yellow card is received by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).

82' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) wastes a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
80' The linesman raises his flag. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
78' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
76' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Here's the latest number of offsides – 2:1.
74' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
73' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.
72' Here is a change. Sandro Tonali is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
71' A substitution has been made. Kieran Trippier goes off and Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
70' Dwight McNeil (Everton) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
69' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jacob Murphy.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jack Harrison will be replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton).
68' One of the Everton players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
67' A rebound falls to Idrissa Gueye (Everton) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
65' Half-chance! Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) plays a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford reacts well to snuff out the attack. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
64' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
62' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Harvey Barnes is replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).

60' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
60' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.

58' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Everton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
57' Today's match ends for Orel Mangala who will be replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Everton).

56' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
55' Jack Harrison (Everton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
53' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

51' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.

49' Everton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+6' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
45+3' Newcastle are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Dwight McNeil (Everton). Craig Pawson doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
41' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Jordan Pickford (Everton).
39' The ball is cleared after Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
39' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
35' The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.

35' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Jordan Pickford to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
34' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is going to take the penalty!
34' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Newcastle!
32' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
32' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Newcastle for a penalty. Play continues.

31' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
30' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes a short corner kick.
29' Wonderful movement by Newcastle. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
26' Nick Pope is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from James Tarkowski (Everton). Easy save!
25' James Garner (Everton) is able to continue to play.
23' James Garner (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
20' Celebrations are cut short for Everton as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
19' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Everton players aren’t happy.
18' Goal! James Garner gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the roof of the net. 0:0.

17' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
16' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Some great play by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Nick Pope sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
14' Orel Mangala (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
12' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
9' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
9' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) offside.
8' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
5' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
5' Everton showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. It's a throw-in for Newcastle.
2' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Everton will kick the game off.
Craig Pawson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
